title: Warrior Frostbreaker Build
lede: A Greatsword build from level 1 to 40 that spends every one of Early Access's 94 trait points. Shields from Pommel Strike and Brace keep you upright, Freeze sets up big vertical hits, and the Longsword is your healing swap.

notice.title: Checked against your Traits screens. Not tested in-game.
notice.text: Both trait trees match your Greatsword and Longsword screens node for node (55 and 60 nodes). Costs follow the in-game markers: nodes marked "3" cost 3, everything else costs 1, and granted skills are free. Where two branches split and rejoin you pick one side, as your Hatchet screen shows. The plan spends exactly 94 points: 47 Coilstones at 2 each. Build choices and stat numbers are my recommendations, tagged as such.

stages.name: Leveling
stages.goal: You start with the Longsword. Switch to the Greatsword as soon as you get one, and put all 22 Diamond Shores points into it.
weapons: Greatsword as soon as you have one (RaidDex's route has a Covenant Greatsword by Lv 15) [one]
Longsword until then, since it's the default weapon [one]
skills: Arc, Chain, Sunder, Vertical, Rising, Final Cleave, Blade Guard and Brace are granted free [ok]
Pommel Strike gives a long shield. While shielded, Brace makes you stagger-immune [ok]
Demolishing Strike counters after a Blade Guard block, and Expert makes it cost no SP [one]
traits: Diamond Shores has 11 Coilstones = 22 points: 2 on the Longsword (Lifeflame healing) and 20 down the Greatsword shield line to Downpour Slash [me]
Trait points only come from Coilstones (2 each), not from levels [ok]
gear: At Lv 20 you have 57 stat points (3 per level) [ok]
check: Spend your first 2 points on Whirlwind Slash → Lifeflame
Get a Greatsword and put it on Q swap
Unlock Pommel Strike → Fatal Cleave → Cross Slash
Get all 11 Diamond Shores Coilstones (22 points)

stages.name: Gearing
stages.goal: Add Cross Slash, Brawl and Rampage to the Greatsword, and build the Longsword's healing core.
skills: Cross Slash → Rain Cleave → Downpour Slash hit harder while you're shielded [ok]
Rampage adds a free charged Final Cleave on Unbridled Might [ok]
Longsword Lifeflame heals on Closing Slash, and Bloodstorm costs HP instead of SP [ok]
traits: Gylden Ruins has 14 Coilstones = +28, for 50 total: Greatsword's Freeze line to Rampage, plus Heavy Kick and Bloodstorm on the Longsword [me]
gear: Raise Talent to 23 total for the endgame weapons. It also adds defense [ok]

stages.name: Endgame
stages.goal: Finish the Greatsword at 53 points, then spend the rest on the Longsword.
skills: Frostfang: Freeze grants Resolve, and Rising Slash adds a long-range hit [ok]
Bloodforge + Bloodthirst turn Longsword skills into heals [ok]
Bladeburst: stationary, immune while it hits. 60 s cooldown [ok]
traits: Astron Plains has 22 Coilstones = +44, for 94. Greatsword finishes at 53 (its maximum) and Longsword gets 41 of its 46 [me]
RaidDex's 56 / 44 assumed 100 points and Wikily's 2-point costs [me]
gear: 117 stat points at Lv 40. RaidDex's 54 STR / 45 CON / 15 END spends most of its defense on HP. This page shifts it toward Endurance [me]
check: Get Scattered Mist and Wrathful Tyrant's Horn
Land Rampage in a boss fight

weaponGuide.intro: Every Warrior starts with the Longsword, the class's default weapon [ok]. Put your first 2 points there (Lifeflame healing), then build the Greatsword as soon as you have one. It's the safer leveling weapon. The Longsword's other skills (Parry, Counterattack, Charge, Pursuit) are free anyway.

pros: Pommel Strike and Brace shields make you stagger-immune, so you can trade hits while you level [ok]
Arc, Chain and Sweeping Slash clear packs, and all three are free [ok]
Rated higher for PvE: AOEAH 9/10, a creator tier list A. Kybuza, Nerd Bird and Theory Forge favor it [ok]
The Freeze line multiplies vertical-slash damage (Clean Cut, Frostfang) [one]
cons: Slow and heavy, with little mobility. Bad at chasing [one]
Heavy swings eat SP, so it needs Endurance [ok]
No self-heal anywhere in the tree [ok]
items.skip: Leveling on the Longsword alone means no shields and more deaths. One Early Access player died more on the Longsword than the Greatsword [one], and the Longsword's PvE rating is C or 7/10 [ok].

items.when: Swap · 2 points first, more from Gylden Ruins
pros: The only Warrior healing: Lifeflame, Bloodstorm, Bloodforge [ok]
Best duelist: AOEAH 10/10 for PvP, a creator tier list S for PvP [ok]
Parry, Counterattack, Charge and Pursuit are free, so it works with 0 points [ok]
cons: Parry timing is unforgiving, and the blood skills cost HP [ok]
Bloodforge ends when you swap weapons [ok]
items.skip: With no healing swap, you lean on your five potions per fight [one], and you give up the class's best PvP weapon.

budgetIntro: Early Access has 47 Raeven's Coilstones at 2 trait points each, 94 in total [one]. Region counts are RaidDex's [one] and level bands are archeagechroniclesdata's [one]. You only reach these totals if you take every Coilstone as you go. Both weapons spend from the same pool, which is why your Longsword screen shows "Available Points: 4/8" after 4 went into the Greatsword.
treeHelp: Click a node to read it. Double-click it, or press Space, to unlock or refund it. ✓ = granted free. Red = locked because you took the other side of that fork. Fill with my points follows the leveling plan across both weapons until your points run out. Saved in this browser.

trees.intro: Matches your Greatsword screen: 14 granted skills on the left, Proficiency at the top, and two 20-node branches. Ten nodes carry the "3" marker. Forks: Armor Break or Frozen Veins, Freeze or Expert, Mastery or Uncontrollable Power, Lightweight or Heavyweight, Swift Cut Freeze or Neutralize, Carve Up or Clean Sweep. Full tree with choices made: 53 points [me].

Matches your Longsword screen: 14 granted skills, Pursuit - Root on its own, a 21-node blood branch, an 18-node Foresight branch, and a stat cluster on the right. Full tree with choices made: 46 points, not counting the stat cluster [me].

plans.name: Frostbreaker: deep first (recommended)
plans.note: All 94 points. Go deep on the shield → Cross Slash line before filling sideways, and mix in Longsword healing early [me].
route: Your first 2 points go to the Longsword, which you start with: Whirlwind Slash → Lifeflame, so Closing Slash heals. Once you have a Greatsword, go straight down the shield line: Pommel Strike → Demolishing Strike → Fatal Cleave → Swift Cut → Cross Slash → Rain Cleave → Downpour Slash. That's RaidDex's whole opener, done by about Lv 20. Only then add Sweeping Slash and Unbridled Might [me].
Heavy Kick and Bloodstorm on the Longsword for healing and bursts, then the Greatsword's left side: Frozen Veins → Frosted Gleam → Brawl → Rampage [me].
Greatsword capstones (Frostfang, Warrior's Cry, Vengeful Rush, Waterspout), then the Longsword's Bloodforge and Foresight lines [me].

rotation.title: Frostbreaker rotation
rotation.intro: RaidDex's Frostbreaker chain [one]. Swap weapons with {Q}.

steps.d: A long shield that scales with Max HP. With Brace (free), you're stagger-immune while it holds.
Cross Slash combos from Arc Slash and hits harder while you're shielded.
Breaks guard and knocks down. Downpour gives Rain Cleave one more use.
With Unbridled Might up, Rampage adds a free charged Final Cleave.

steps.t: Loop Arc, Chain and Sweeping Slash
steps.d: Clean Sweep spends extra SP to repeat Sweeping Slash. Frosted Gleam re-opens Final Cleave.

steps.t: Block, then Demolishing Strike → Fatal Cleave
steps.d: Blade Guard while shielded, counter with Demolishing Strike (free with Expert), then Fatal Cleave strips shields.

rotation.after: When SP or health runs low, swap to the Longsword with {Q} for Lifeflame and Bloodstorm healing.

disputes: Wikily lists many nodes at 2 points. The in-game screens only ever show a "3" marker.
Unmarked nodes cost 1. Your Berserker screen had 4 points pending on four of those nodes [me].
RaidDex: STR, then plenty of CON, then END. DeityVengy runs END first. AAC Tools' demo values per point: END +6.6 SP and +4.2 defense, CON +7.2 HP, Talent +0.8 defense.
STR first, Endurance second, CON third, and Talent to the weapon requirement [me].
Creator tier list: Longsword C for PvE. AOEAH: Longsword 7/10 PvE, 10/10 PvP. Kybuza, Nerd Bird and Theory Forge favor the Greatsword.
Greatsword main, Longsword as the healing swap.
Older guides say 92 or 100. RaidDex's Coilstone list: 47 stones × 2 = 94.

carry.intro: Each weapon has its own tree, but both spend from one shared point pool [ok]. Below, I sort every effect by what its node text actually says. Ends on swap means the text says so. Only that weapon covers nodes that change that weapon's own skills or say "equipped weapon". Unconfirmed means the text doesn't say either way, so I'm not guessing. One creator video reports a global cooldown when you swap mid-combo [one].

cols.label: Ends on swap (node text says so)
items: Bloodforge (Longsword): "removed on weapon swap". Don't swap mid-Bloodforge [ok]

cols.label: Only that weapon
items: Skill upgrades only change that weapon's own skills: Demolishing Strike - Expert, Rampage, Clean Cut, the Whirlwind and Bloodstorm Masteries, and so on [ok]
Longsword stat cluster: Weapon Physical / Magic ATK ↑ say "weapon ATK", so they apply only while the Longsword is out [ok]
Lifeflame heals only when a Longsword Closing Slash lands [ok]

cols.label: Unconfirmed: test before relying on it
items: Pommel Strike, Retaliate and Brace shields: no node says they end on swap [me]
Stat nodes: Greatsword Physical PEN +12, Longsword Wind ATK +20 and Physical Amplification +25. No node says whether they count for the other weapon [me]
Sharpwake stacks (crit and damage for 20 s) [me]

test: Stat nodes: open the Character screen with the weapon whose tree has the node (for example, Warhammer for its Fire ATK +20) and note the value. Press {Q}, then reopen the screen. If the number didn't change, the node counts for both weapons.
Shields and buffs: start the effect (a shield or timed buff), press {Q} right away, and watch the buff bar or shield. If the icon stays, it carries over.
Tell me what you see and I'll update the page. Until then, those rows stay marked as unconfirmed.
